notes.title: Patch 00.00.01.01
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506114/66445467752f2daab307e486dec819c1f86ed004.jpg[/img]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added /puke @name lobby emote.
[*] Added /carebear @name lobby emote.
[*] Melee and Armor now show stats in loot window.
[*] Meele and Armor now show compared stats in loot window if you have something equipped.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Change some settings for the dynamic rules to make matches more intense and a bit quicker.
[*] Mounts now slow down a bit quicker regardless of stats.
[*] Renamed “Doors” to “Breakable Doors”
[*] Renamed “Fortress Chest” to “Lockpickable Chest”
[*] Increased the damage on the Worn Shortsword.
[*] If you kill the rider of a mount you can now tame that mount.
[*] Dead players will now see chat from the living.
[*] Improved the map with more mountain passages to prevent players from getting trapped by the storm.
[*] Lowered devotion level for /thunder @name from 15 to 10
[*] Removed some unnecessary loot from wheelbarrows.
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed embarrassing typos in the help menu.
[*] Fixed a couple of issues with the buttons in the help menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 19 December
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506114/f4ae75ee3477062c9740a39a67ed4d48179a2882.jpg[/img]

[h1]We made some minor changes today aimed at mainly helping new players better understand the combat.[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a simple help button and guide for new players in the searching for server window. It's still very basic but much better than nothing.
[*] Players with DLC will now have yellow devotion level.
[*] Updated the map in the game to better reflect the world. It should now be easier to find ways over mountains using the map.
[*] Using mouse direction for directional blocking is now default off.
[*] Using mouse direction for directional melee is now default off.
[*] VOIP (not implemented) will no longer try to connect.
[*] Use player to trade defaults to off
[/list]

[i]This is none-versioned fix meaning the version numbers will not update.
If you don't see the "open help" button in the character screen simply close the game and let steam update.[/i]

notes.title: Combat tutorial for all you new folks!
notes.content:
We have heard you loud and clear we need to build a much better tutorial and improve the ways we teach the player to play the game.

We are currently working mainly on this but in the meantime Teknique made a simple combat tutorial for that you can check out right here:
https://youtu.be/OL63OzPMa10

notes.title: Early access release TODAY
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506114/ec1efcf480df8a6297b56f2d3aa712624fe75692.jpg[/img]

[b]It's happening![/b]
Today we will start the open alpha of Mortal Royale and the game will officially be available for everyone to download for free on steam!
Tell you friends and parents to join the launch at 09:00 PST!

[b]New trailer[/b]
At the exact release time we will also premier the new trailer on youtube.
You can follow the release and chat with us here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mx8HuNvtVMY

[b]Thanks to all our testers[/b]
We have had a lot of people trying out the game during the closed alpha and your feedback has really helped shape the game.
There's a lot of changes based of your input and this alpha is in a much better shape than the first closed alpha mainly thanks to you.

So thank you all for your bug-reports and feedback it has really helped us out a lot and we look forward to getting more if it now that everyone can try out the game.

notes.title: Phase 8 starts 7th December 12 AM (CEWT)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506114/65df3c37e89506835c88b40973914dcd4278b6e9.jpg[/img]
[b]Hi there Community!
[/b]
This Friday the 7th of December at 12 AM Central European Winter Time (CEWT), UTC +1, we will start the servers for another test session!
You can use this site to see what time that is for you: [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/converter.html?iso=20181207T110000&p1=293&p2=179&p3=137]Convert Time Zones[/url].

The main purpose this time is to open up the servers for Steams Test Process so that we are good to go when the upcoming Early Access release approaches. (No ETA)
This means that ALL servers will be up and running, and without any lowest players limit. Which can lead to matches starting with only 1 player.


We are also trying to get some nice changes into the patch such as:
[list]
[*] You should no longer get trapped inside your horse/mount.
[*] Fixed an issue where players sometime could become invisible to each other.
[*] You can now sprint in ghost mode to move around faster during the start countdown.
[*] You can now fast delete items in your inventory by pressing Alt+Right Clicking on the item.
[*] Added a couple of new semi-rare random loot structures such as Tents and Wagons.
[*] Loot containers such as corpses, wheelbarrows etc. now has a random yaw rotation to make them look less static.
[/list]

Hope to see you all on the battlefield!

notes.title: Closed Alpha Phase 5
notes.content:
[b]Hi there Community![/b]


[b]This Friday the 2nd of November at 18:00 Central European Winter Time (CEST), UTC +1,  we will start a single server.[/b]

The server will be open and take in players for a very, very long time or until we reach our target.

The aim here is to stress the server out, see what happens when lots of players enters the same game and what changes we need to make to improve that experience.

Alienware & SteelSeries have setup a special page on their end where anyone can get a key to try it out.

We will link you to that site once it's up so that if you don't have a key you can simply get one through them.

Hopefully this will also bring in a lot of new people who see the game for the first time through their massive network.

This time we will be streaming at https://www.twitch.tv/starvault and try to respond to any questions you have about the MR and it's future development.

Clear you calendars, it's time to see what a real battle can look like.
